newsitem.title: UK: Freight market quieter on grain stems shortage.
newsitem.headline: Freight market quieter on grain stems shortage.

text.p: The freight market was relatively quiet ahead of the Easter holidays.

The shortage of grain stems from the Mississippi has persisted but some brokers also noted a general lack of business quoted in the Pacific. The BFI reflected the slightly easier conditions and fell 6 points to 1518.

GRAIN - E.Coast S.America was again the most active grain chartering area. Toepfer were reported to have fixed out 50,000 wheat Plate/Aqaba for mid-April on subjects in the low $30.00's and Cereol booked the 1982-built Sonic Youth for 47,500 heavy grain Up River plus Rio Grande to 2 ports Italian Adriatic for early April $1.2m lumpsum with 12 total days. Seatrans were said to have fixed and failed with Atlantic Princess 73,500 dwt delivery Ghent retro 22 March for a trip via E.Coast S.America to the far east at $15,250 daily but confirmed Theonymphos 66,700 dwt delivery prompt Lorient for 3-5 month redelivery Atlantic at a firm level close to $11,850 daily.

Aifanourios 60,920 dwt was rumoured fixed by Marifran Plate/Skaw-Passero and Cereol fixed Arosa 1,287,000 cft grain from the Plate to Vado and Seville with heavy grain and soyabean meal at a lumpsum of $650,000 basis 1-2 and 7 total days for 4/9 April.

Grand Moulin fixed the over-age Gemini 29,000 dwt delivery prompt N.France for a trip with grain products to Yemen at $10,000 daily. In the Pacific Tradigrain were linked with the Halla-relet Bechet for 54,000 heavy grain Nopac/Taiwan for early April at $15.40 (having failed with Nordmoritz at $16.00), although some brokers linked Hanjin Casablanca with this business.

MINERALS - There was a fair volume of caper fixing ahead of the holidays but rates generally remained soft. A number of fixtures in the east were not fully reported - Merchant Prestige 161,010 dwt was linked with Bocimar for Gladstone coal to Antwerp (possibly at about $10.75), and P and O were said to have fixed Eridge 122,792 dwt to Chinese charterers for a W Australian round at close to $16,750 daily. In the Atlantic China steel covered 3 cargoes of 120,000 ironore Tubarao option PDM/Kaohsiung for April/May at between $9.50 and $9.80.

Orfeas was fixed on subjects for 110,000 coal La Cienaga/Rotterdam for 5/15 April by Yukong at $5.40, and Vakis T 130,000 dwt was understood also fixed on subjects for similar business. Golden Cape 123,000 dwt was booked from the Continent early April for a transatlantic round redelivery Continent on private terms.

Although reports circulated that Maratha Messenger 71,252 dwt was fixed by Yukong on subjects for an Australian round there was a shortage of reported pananax fixtures in the far east, and some believed a shortage of orders as well.
But the Arabian Gulf/Indian Ocean remained firm and Ever Mighty 75,265 dwt was understood taken on subjects by unnamed charterers delivery Muscat for 5-7 months at a firm $13,500 daily.

HANDIES - The Atlantic was quite active. Loki Carriers fixed the 1982-built Chigirin 38,510 dwt delivery Morocco for 5-7 months at $6,500 daily and Canadian Forest took 29,000 dwt delivery prompt Algeria for the Lakes season at close to $7,250 daily.

Hector 27,676 dwt was fixed for scrap from the continent to Turkey and Favorita 44,537 dwt from the continent to the far east, both on private terms. UBT booked a vessel of about 37,000 dwt for alumina from Matanzas to Murmansk at $9,000 daily plus a small bonus and also a 33,000 dwt vessel delivery Conakry trip Murmansk at $7,500 daily. Western Bulkcarriers fixed a gearless Polish-flag 33,000 dwt vessel from the Baltic to the US Gulf at $6,500 daily. Van Ommeren were linked with a 35,000 dwt bulker delivery Puerto Bolivar trip Brayton Point at $9,500 daily and Safmarine fixed Land 37,991 dwt delivery US Gulf trip S.Africa at $10,000 daily plus $75,000 bonus.

In the east World Utility 44,000 dwt was fixed on subjects and Kapit Betkher 36,663 dwt went to Wanless delivery prompt Niihama for an Australian round at $8,500 daily. Tokai covered a 23,000 dwt logcarrier for a Pacific round with potash at $7,000 daily, and Anangel Honour 22,670 dwt was booked delivery Indonesia for an Australian round at $5,750/6,000 daily.
